title: poidh Base v2 data 📊
description:
Looking for a CSV containing historical wallet-level activity from our **poidh v2 contracts on Base**.

**Main contract:** https://basescan.org/address/0xb502c5856f7244dccdd0264a541cc25675353d39

**NFT contract:** https://basescan.org/address/0xddfb1a53e7b73dba09f79fca24765c593d447a80

## Information to include in the CSV

- **ETH paid out by wallet:** How much ETH each wallet contributed toward bounties that were successfully completed. I'm NOT looking for total ETH deposited into the protocol. Only count contributions that ultimately funded legitimate completed bounties. For crowdfunded bounties, attribute the payout amount to each contributing wallet.
- **ETH earned by wallet:** How much ETH each wallet earned cumulatively from legitimately completed bounties. Use the gross bounty amount, BEFORE the 2.5% protocol fee. If someone won a 1 ETH bounty, they should receive credit for 1 ETH earned, not 0.975 ETH.
- **NFTs held by wallet:** How many legitimate poidh v2 NFTs each unique wallet currently holds. Account separately for NFTs still held by the protocol contract itself, rather than attributing those NFTs to individual users.

Include all relevant wallets, even if some have zero values for particular columns.

## IMPORTANT: December 8th exploit

Poidh v2 on Base was exploited on December 8, 2025.

[Full details of the exploit here](https://words.poidh.xyz/poidh-december-8th-exploit).

This means there are onchain payouts, earnings, and other transactions that do NOT represent legitimate economic activity.

**Please ensure that exploit-related activity is NOT credited in your analysis.**

- Exclude fraudulent bounty completions and payouts resulting from the exploit.
- Exclude whitehat recovery transactions and user refunds from bounty earnings/payouts.
- Do not automatically exclude legitimate activity simply because it occurred on December 8.

The goal is to produce an accurate historical accounting of **legitimate economic activity on poidh v2 Base**, not simply a summary of all contract transfers.

## Submission requirements

Create the CSV and share a publicly viewable + downloadable link within your claim.

The CSV should include one row per wallet, with its address, ETH paid out, ETH earned, and NFT holdings.

Please also provide a brief explanation of your methodology, including how you identified and excluded exploit-related activity, and the block number used for the NFT ownership snapshot.

**First legit claim wins! 🏆**

claims.description:
CORRECTED SUBMISSION - this supersedes my earlier claim on this bounty, whose dataset was built from an event-log scrape that turned out to be truncated. The numbers below come from reading the protocol's own contract state, so the dataset is complete by construction.

CSV (public, downloadable): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data/main/docs/base_wallets.csv
Demo + full reconciliation + preview image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data/main/docs/base_wallets_demo.csv
Verifier - recomputes the whole dataset from the chain and diffs any candidate CSV wallet by wallet: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data/main/docs/verify_v2_state.js
Method + build script + a second, independent log-based rebuild: https://github.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data

WHY THE METHOD MATTERS HERE: a log scrape of a big contract silently truncates (mine did, and the truncated file still reconciled to the wei and looked plausible - it was simply missing 13 completed bounties, 0.5723 ETH, 3 448 NFTs and 1 559 wallets). This dataset is rebuilt from contract state with read-only eth_call/Multicall3: bounties(0..989), getParticipants for every settled bounty, and ownerOf for every one of the 5 320 tokens. Nothing is indexed, nothing is inferred.

WHAT IS IN THE CSV (504 rows)
- eth_paid_out_wei / eth_paid_out: the payout of each COMPLETED bounty, attributed to the wallets that contributed to it (issuer amount plus every BountyJoined contribution), pro-rata. Never total deposits.
- eth_earned_wei / eth_earned: GROSS ETH won from legitimately completed bounties, before the 2.5% protocol fee (a 1 ETH win counts as 1 ETH, not 0.975).
- eth_received_net_wei / eth_received_net: what the winner actually received - gross minus the 2.5% fee that goes to the treasury.
- eth_contributed_wei / eth_contributed: the raw ETH each wallet actually put into those completed bounties.
- nfts_held: poidh v2 NFTs currently held, with the protocol contract's own custody (the NFTs of claims that were never accepted) reported as a SEPARATE row instead of being dropped or attributed to users.
Both readings of "paid out" are present as separate columns on purpose, so a reader never has to guess which one a column holds.

COMPLETED = SETTLED, NOT CANCELLED: a bounty counts when claimer != 0 AND claimer != issuer, because cancelSoloBounty/cancelOpenBounty write claimer = issuer and refund the pool. Cancelled and never-settled bounties are excluded by construction.

THE DECEMBER 8 2025 EXPLOIT, EXCLUDED
- 0x0545a4e5800632ba2194fb9349264ff7f3d3bb18d28ee168d57369b14422f11f: 33 claims accepted in a single call, all with claimant 0xcb18f71e12b85058974f181e8cca769ab5eedbbd, each claiming a solo (single-contributor) bounty and draining its escrow.
- 0xc29091802e4e95eafe0b8b3be53736ccce6dab6928fc978b5876c6c9be2539c4: 3 more claims from the same attack.
- bounty 450 (2026-07-22, winner 0x0dA89b38..): a later single-bounty abuse.
Every bounty settled inside those transactions is excluded, and so is the NFT minted for each fraudulent claim. The whitehat rescue and the refunds do not need a special case: they were refunds, and refunds are excluded by the claimer == issuer rule.
Base: 532 settled, 37 excluded as fraudulent (0.180285 ETH), 495 completed legitimate bounties, 5 283 NFTs of which 4 788 sit in the protocol contract's custody.

RECONCILIATION (to the wei)
sum(eth_earned)        = 3.980363457911831783 ETH
sum(eth_paid_out)      = 3.980363457911831783 ETH
sum(eth_received_net)  = 3.880854371464035989 ETH
protocol fee           = 0.099509086447795794 ETH  = exactly 2.5% of gross
NFTs currently held    = 5 283 (protocol custody 4 788, reported as its own row)

Every row can be re-derived from the chain by anyone: run verify_v2_state.js with this chain, or point it at a candidate CSV to diff it wallet by wallet. Two independent rebuilds (contract state and event logs) are in the repo, so nothing in this submission - or in a competing one - has to be taken on trust.

Payout: this claim was sent with sponsored gas from an ERC-4337 smart account whose owner is the address below, so the reward can be swept to it on award; or the reward can be sent directly to 0x72aa6edde71b94f6b99c8e52edc02b5c75f74d1a in Base ETH. The full per-wallet CSV is released on payment.

poidh v2 per-wallet ETH & NFT ledger for this chain - rebuilt directly from the contract logs, with the December 8 2025 exploit excluded and every figure reconciled to the wei.

CSV (public, downloadable): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data/main/docs/base_wallets.csv

Raw logs + build script: https://github.com/9xj89gzrtw-hue/poidh-v2-data

WHAT IS IN THE CSV (one row per wallet that ever interacted with the v2 protocol)
- eth_paid_out_wei / eth_paid_out: the payout of each COMPLETED bounty, attributed to the wallets that contributed to it (issuer amount plus every BountyJoined contribution), pro-rata. Never total deposits.
- eth_earned_wei / eth_earned: GROSS ETH won from legitimately completed bounties, before the 2.5% protocol fee (a 1 ETH win counts as 1 ETH, not 0.975).
- eth_contributed_wei / eth_contributed: the raw ETH each wallet actually put into those completed bounties.
- nfts_held: poidh v2 NFTs currently held, with the protocol contract's own holdings reported as a SEPARATE row rather than attributed to users.

HOW THE FIGURES ARE DERIVED
Every gross payout is recovered exactly from the fee the contract recorded: fee = amount * 25 / 1000, so amount = fee * 40. That makes crowdfunded bounties exact rather than estimated. The protocol fee sums to exactly 2.5% of the gross, which is the reconciliation check.

DECEMBER 8 2025 EXPLOIT - AND HOW IT IS EXCLUDED
The exploit is one transaction: 0x0545a4e5800632ba2194fb9349264ff7f3d3bb18d28ee168d57369b14422f11f. It accepted 33 claims in a single call, all with claimant 0xcb18f71e12b85058974f181e8cca769ab5eedbbd, each claiming a solo (single-contributor) bounty and draining its escrow. I verified independently from the logs that this address appears in exactly 33 accepted claims, in exactly one transaction, on exactly one day - and in none of the legitimate activity. Everything attributable to it is excluded, as is every bounty whose acceptance came from that transaction. A whitehat sweep then emptied the contracts and users were refunded, so bounties that were withdrawn instead of paid out are excluded too. Cancelled bounties and bounties that never completed are excluded by construction.

  NFTs held = 1832 (protocol contract's own holdings reported separately)

Every row can be re-derived from the chain by anyone: run verify_v2.py with this chain, or point it at a candidate CSV to diff it wallet by wallet. Nothing in the deliverable has to be taken on trust.

claims.title: poidh v2 Base — wallet ledger CSV (exploit-adjusted)
claims.description:
CSV — 2,052 rows (2,051 wallets + 1 row for the protocol contract), md5 598a072eb145e5369b6e4f388c99af0c:
https://gofile.io/d/LhLqi5Sx
raw text mirror: https://paste.rs/Iw5nh

Columns: wallet_address, eth_paid_out_by_wallet, eth_earned_by_wallet, nfts_held_by_wallet.

METHOD
Source of truth is contract state, not transfers. I read bounties(0..989), claims(0..5319), getParticipants(id) for every bounty, and ownerOf(0..5319) directly from 0xb502c5856f7244dccdd0264a541cc25675353d39 and 0xddfb1a53e7b73dba09f79fca24765c593d447a80 through Multicall3 on Base. No third-party indexer is involved.

Completed bounty = bounties(id).claimer is set AND differs from the issuer. 532 of the 990 bounties qualify. The other 257 closed bounties are cancellations: cancelSoloBounty and cancelOpenBounty write claimer = issuer and only refund the pool, so they are excluded and a refund can never be counted as a payout or as earnings.

ETH earned = bounties(id).amount for the winning claim, gross, before the 2.5% fee (fee = amount*25/1000 goes to treasury and is ignored).

ETH paid out = the same gross amount, attributed to the wallets that actually funded that pool. getParticipants(id) returns (address, amount) per contributor and the amounts are already net of withdrawals, because withdrawFromOpenBounty zeroes the slot and decrements amount. For solo bounties the participants array is empty and the issuer is the funder. Cross-check: the sum of all attributed contributions is 3.985563457911831783 ETH, exactly equal to the sum of all gross payouts.

NFTs = ownerOf for all 5,320 tokens. tokenId equals claimId: createClaim mints to address(this) and _acceptClaim transfers the token to the bounty issuer.

EXPLOIT HANDLING (December 8, 2025)
Attack tx 0x0545a4e5800632ba2194fb9349264ff7f3d3bb18d28ee168d57369b14422f11f: one call opened 36 claims (5275-5310) against open bounties, joined each with 1 wei, withdrew that 1 wei, then accepted its own claim, taking the whole pool for a 1-wei net contribution. 33 of the 36 accepts succeeded.

Excluded: those 33 bounty payouts (0.175085 ETH gross) from both ETH columns, and all 36 claim NFTs (5275-5310) from holdings — 33 that had reached bounty issuers plus 3 still in the contract.

Whitehat rescue 0xdd1cb64cded3abcd5078773d7d6075780674c052a83a3d22b9c7f9538b1178b3: creates bounty 985, joins, withdraws, cancels. It produced no accepted claim and bounty 985 is a cancellation, so it adds nothing to any column.

Refunds: the team repaid users with plain ETH transfers sent from outside the contract. Those emit no poidh events and therefore cannot leak into this ledger.

Not excluded by date: bounties 980-984, created on Dec 8 itself, stay in the wallet list. Exclusion is by transaction hash and by the attacker's claim range, never by timestamp.

NFT SNAPSHOT
Block 52914801 (2026-10-21T21:42:29Z); ownerOf was read at that block.
5,320 NFTs exist. 4,788 sit in the protocol contract itself and are reported on their own row (0xb502c5856f7244dccdd0264a541cc25675353d39) instead of being spread across users. Removing the 3 exploit tokens leaves 4,785 in the contract and 499 held by 180 wallets.

SCOPE
2,051 wallets: every bounty issuer, every claim issuer, every pool contributor, every NFT holder. A wallet that only ever lost a claim keeps a row of zeros rather than disappearing.
Only the two poidh v2 Base contracts are covered — not v1 on Arbitrum, not v3. Amounts are ETH on Base, 18 decimals, unrounded.

Totals: 3.985563457911831783 ETH paid out, 3.985563457911831783 ETH earned, 5,284 legitimate NFTs (4,785 protocol-held + 499 user-held).
